structure: CSharp branch/tap stages use ordinary flow inference/emission, including scalar container queries. Parallel branch now preserves one target descriptor per stage with an optional callable function; readonly zero-argument intrinsic queries require no callable symbol. Shared ResolveLocal loads actual readonly capture headers instead of placeholders.
branches: Sequential entry and ordinary function, parallel readonly source and named owner terminal tap. Preserve effectful/async/move/mutable-argument restrictions; readonly query stages have no function callbacks or extra parameters.
logic: Current Native branch arm finalizers and branchStageFlowIndex enumerate only kind6 declared calls. Tap finalization binds kind6 and println opcodes only. Check actual intrinsic IR and bind the same primary/previous-stage value and terminal result for all resolved junction stages.
diagnostics: Preserve exact CSharp S003 fixed-length warnings for the new dynamic-array probes; do not suppress them. New parallel query positive is supported after CSharp semantic/capture fixes.
implementationDecision: Share junction input AST facts with canonical recursive type inference; select call and intrinsic IR stages in both finalizers. Bind intrinsic primary operands explicitly, preserve declared-call implicit input handling, and reuse existing query emitters in callbacks with real source/previous-stage SSA values. Do not create synthetic function symbols or duplicate intrinsic implementations.
productTypeRootCause: Actual len expression and arm IR are Int, but the product declaration still has UIntSize for its second field. resolvePaths skips an already-created branch product even after its terminal target type becomes canonical. Its existing reintern/update branch is unreachable under that outer guard. Recompute branch products from final canonical arm types in each changed dependency round; retain separate immutable product identities instead of mutating the old field table.
readonlyQueryDispatch: Native dispatch reuses len, capacity, BitSet count and only Arena used (raw operation2), matching CSharp zero-argument readonly query admission. Other raw Arena operations cannot enter this query adapter.
